requirement_vague: Verify empty feed is returned when user follows nobody

omissions.description: The GET /api/articles/feed endpoint is entirely missing from the code. There is no route that handles feed requests for authenticated users, which should return articles from followed authors (and an empty result when the user follows nobody).
omissions.reasoning: Searching all route definitions in the code, there is no @app.get('/api/articles/feed') handler. The requirement specifies that user1 GETs /api/articles/feed and receives articlesCount=0 and an empty articles array, but this endpoint does not exist at all in the implementation.
